subject: BlueNova renewal paperwork: term, capacity and insurance clarifications
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluenova.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: evan.cole@bluenova.com
Date: 2027-08-02T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork for BlueNova — proposed term & capacity

Markus,

Thanks for sending the draft. Evan and I reviewed the MSA + order form and we attached our redline (BlueNova_Redline_0802.docx). A few summary items from Legal/Procurement:

- Term: We prefer a 24-month term, but need a mutual early-termination clause tied to material breach and a 90-day notice for non-renewal.
- Capacity: BlueNova is requesting an immediate +30% reserved capacity uplift for year 1 with a 10% step-up in year 2. We will accept phased billing but need a clear ramp schedule in Exhibit A.
- Insurance & Indemnity: Our counsel is asking for an updated cyber insurance clause (limit to $5M) and a small carve-out for data breach remediations.
- SLA credits: We proposed a simplified credit schedule; your team’s redline removed the 3rd tier credit. Need confirmation on how credits are calculated for multi-region failures.

Can your legal ops team review the attached and let us know which items are negotiable vs. non-starters? Evan is on procurement and will handle order-of-signature once terms settle.

Best,
Jenna Park
Senior Counsel, BlueNova Systems
jenna.park@bluenova.com

Attachment: BlueNova_Redline_0802.docx (Word redline of MSA + Exhibit A)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluenova.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork for BlueNova — proposed term & capacity

Jenna — thanks for the redline and the clear summary. I looped in Marissa (Sales Ops) and Karthik (Legal liaison) so we can triage quickly. Quick responses to your bullets: 

- Term: 24 months is fine from our side provided we retain the ability to invoice for committed capacity through end of term. We can accept a 90-day non-renewal window.
- Capacity: We can support a +30% reserved capacity uplift in year 1 and +10% in year 2, but request a phased activation (50% on day-1 of the renewal, 50% after 90 days) to smooth provisioning. We'll capture the ramp in Exhibit A.
- Insurance: Redwood maintains a $3M cyber policy as standard; we can discuss an endorsement to reach $5M but will need underwriting lead time.
- SLA credits: We propose keeping the 3-tier credit structure; removing it materially increases operational risk for us. If BlueNova insists on simplification, we can propose a cap on total credits per month (e.g., 25% of monthly committed invoice).

I'll attach a short markup with the proposed phasing and the term carve language for legal to consider. Can your team confirm whether the insurance endorsement is a blocker for countersignature?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
Office: +1 415 555 0193

Attachment: RNW_proposed_changes_0802.pdf (high-level proposed edits)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: BlueNova renewal paperwork — triage notes for legal / sales ops

Markus / Karthik — forwarding Jenna’s redline and my quick triage. Below are the prioritized asks for Legal Ops and Sales Ops to action before we loop BlueNova back: 

1) Term & Cancellation 
- Proposed language: 24-month term; early termination for material breach with 90-day cure period; billing for committed capacity through EOT.

2) Capacity phasing 
- Exhibit A should show: Year 1 committed tokens = baseline *1.30 but activated 50% at renewal, 50% at +90 days. Billing: prorated for activation dates.

3) Insurance endorsement feasibility (Legal) 
- Karthik: can Legal Ops confirm if Redwood can secure an endorsement to $5M or provide alternate mitigation language (e.g., higher liability cap tied to separate SOW)? If underwriting is required, provide ETA.

4) SLA credits 
- Ops prefers keeping the 3-tier schedule. If BlueNova pushes simplification, propose cap wording: "Aggregate monthly credits shall not exceed 25% of the monthly committed invoice."

5) Signature path & procurement 
- Evan (procurement) will need a single DocuSign envelope with MSA + Order Form + Exhibit A. Jenna, ask Evan to confirm required signers.

I’ll prepare a clean counter (Markus, I’ll use RNW_proposed_changes_0802.pdf as the basis) and push to DocuSign once Legal gives the green light.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluenova.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: evan.cole@bluenova.com
Date: 2027-08-04T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueNova renewal paperwork: term, capacity and insurance clarifications

Marissa / Markus — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed your phasing proposal and BlueNova can accept the 50/50 activation schedule for year 1 with the Year 2 +10% step-up. On insurance: underwriting at BlueNova confirmed $5M is a strong preference but not an absolute blocker; if Redwood cannot get an endorsement in time, we’ll accept a reasonable alternative (e.g., an escrowed remediation fund tied to incidents).

SLA credits: BlueNova accepts your cap approach (25% monthly cap) if you can confirm the multi-region failure handling language.

Next steps: Evan will prepare the DocuSign envelope once we agree on final language for Exhibit A and the insurance fallback. I attached BlueNova_Final_Redline_0804.docx with a couple of small language tweaks — mostly clarifying the ramp dates.

Best,
Jenna

Attachment: BlueNova_Final_Redline_0804.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@bluenova.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-05T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Final countersign path & DocuSign envelope (BlueNova DN-4721)

Jenna — great, appreciate the flexibility. Per Marissa’s plan and Karthik’s input (legal provided on a separate thread), we will: 

- Accept 24-month term with the stated early-termination cure language.
- Capture capacity phasing in Exhibit A as: 50% committed on renewal effective date, 50% at +90 days; Year 2 = baseline * 1.10.
- Confirm SLA credits with 3-tier structure and monthly aggregate cap of 25%.
- Insurance fallback: Redwood will pursue endorsement to $5M; if not feasible prior to signature, we will include the remediation escrow language as an interim mitigation.

Marissa — please send the DocuSign envelope with: MSA (final), Order Form (with committed capacities & billing schedule), Exhibit A (phasing table). Jenna / Evan — please confirm signers. Once DocuSign is complete I’ll countersign and return the final PDF (Markus_Countersign_0805.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Markus Klein
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachment: Markus_Countersign_0805.pdf (to be added after signature)
